influences.name: Dave Swarbrick
influences.context: I was about 13 and my brother who was older came home with some LPs like Dave Swarbrick and Martin Cathy. The first time I heard Dave Swarbrick's music I fell in love with it, with the sound, with the spirit of it and with his musicality.

influences.name: Peter Knight
influences.context: Another big early influence was Peter Knight from Steeleye Span

influences.name: Robin Dransfield
influences.context: Another big early influence was Peter Knight from Steeleye Span, and Robin and Barry Dransfield and Aly Bain too.

influences.name: Kevin Burke
influences.context: Then later the Irish players Kevin Burke and some of the old players like John Doherty.

influences.name: John Mclaughlin
influences.context: Then a visionary friend a school, who was streets ahead turned me on to John Mclaughlin and The Mahavishnu Orchestra

influences.name: Jerry Goodman
influences.context: So, I came across Jerry Goodman, who was the only person other than Dave Swarbrick who plugged the violin in at that time. Jerry Goodman with Flock just showed the instrument could go anywhere.

influences.name: The Corries
influences.context: The Corries too, who built these Combolin instruments which was unusual in traditional Scottish music, so I got the idea from early on that there's not only one way.

influences.name: Jefferson Airplane
influences.context: the band was initially influenced by American folk-rock and even nicknamed "the British Jefferson Airplane"

influences.name: Sandy Denny
influences.context: Sandy joined us directly from the folk clubs
